# Foot Ulcer(Archived)

**Authors:** Amara Abid, Shayan Hosseinzadeh

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Foot ulceration is among the most common health issues, and its prevalence has increased recently. It is 1 of the major causes of amputations, particularly in patients with uncontrolled diabetes (see Image. Diabetic Foot Ulcer). The lifetime risk of developing a foot ulcer in patients with diabetes is more than 33%. Diabetic foot ulcer causes a lot of morbidities and accounts for approximately two-thirds of all United States non-traumatic amputations. Infections in these patients are thought to be limb-threatening conditions.
